name: Clara
long_description:
Clara is an AI primary care and longevity practice from the team that founded and grew Circle Medical to $100M in revenue.

Our mission at Clara is to add one billion years of healthspan to humanity. We do this with an AI with deep clinical knowledge, coupled with the ability to sift through medical data to detect trends and patterns that could be missed.

Unlike Claude or ChatGPT, Clara can see your medical data and then act. Chat with Clara as you would a doctor and Clara can help with you make sense of symptoms, get medication refills, order and understand labs, and achieve health goals. Medical recommendations are preliminary until one of our human medical providers in the loop reviews and approves them.

founders.title: Founder/CEO

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder and Product Designer at Clara. Previously designed consumer app experiences at Instagram, Careem (Acquired by Uber), Circle Medical (YC15).

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Nurse practitioner, clinical leader, and co-founder at Clara Health. Previously led clinical operations and quality at Circle Medical (S15).

launches.title: Clara - AI-powered primary care doctor
launches.tagline: Clara is an AI-powered primary care doctor that reads your whole medical history, diagnoses and treats. Licensed in 50 states, with clinicians reviewing all medical decisions.
launches.body:
Clara is an AI primary care doctor. AI does the heavy lifting — pulling your full medical history from 150,000+ hospitals, reading every lab against your goals, drafting refills and orders — and a licensed clinician in your state reviews and approves every clinical decision.

Clara is a fully licensed primary care practice in all 50 states and can be your PCP or work alongside them.

[ ](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1wHNEC0dLb3QD-VTngrig1o8TMDjtE2R5/view)

Clara is built by the team that founded and scaled Circle Medical to over $100M in revenue, and has raised $12M pre-seed from YC and A.Capital.

Try it free: <https://askclara.com>.
